title: Harry Kane wins the Ballon d'Or
lines: Harry Kane has won the Ballon d'Or, football's most famous individual award.
The Bayern Munich striker is the first English winner in twenty-five years, since Michael Owen in two thousand and one.
He is the fifth Englishman ever to win it.
Kane scored seventy-three goals for club and country last season.
Kylian Mbappé finished second, and Lamine Yamal third.
Yamal did win the Young Talent award.
The ceremony was held in London, and the trophy was presented by Cristiano Ronaldo.
In the women's game, Spain's Alexia Putellas won the Ballon d'Or for a third time.
Paris Saint-Germain were named men's club of the year, and Barcelona women's club of the year.
Embarrassingly, hours before the ceremony, the Ballon d'Or website briefly published articles naming three different winners.
For England fans, it's the end of a twenty-five-year wait.
